alert.title: Alert
alert.description: Displays a callout for user attention.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Displays an indicator showing the completion progress of a task, typically displayed as a progress bar.

spinner.title: Spinner
spinner.description: A visual indicator that content is being loaded.

toast.title: Toast
toast.description: Transient feedback message with semantic variants.

notificationCenter.title: Notification Center
notificationCenter.description: Popover-based inbox for unread activity and quick actions.

statusBar.title: StatusBar
statusBar.description: Bottom fixed utility bar with left, center and right regions.

progressWidget.title: ProgressWidget
progressWidget.description: Metric card showing title, value, progress bar, and optional subtext.

stepper.title: Stepper
stepper.description: A multi-step progress indicator with completed, current, and upcoming states.

stickyNoticeBar.title: StickyNoticeBar
stickyNoticeBar.description: A single fixed site-announcement slot at an explicitly selected top or bottom edge.

toastProvider.title: Toast Provider
toastProvider.description: Global toast stack manager for showing transient feedback messages.

statusScreen.title: StatusScreen
statusScreen.description: Full-page status feedback for not-found, error, offline, forbidden, maintenance, and coming-soon states.

safetyBanner.title: SafetyBanner
safetyBanner.description: Persistent, assertive, acknowledgeable safety alert: a loud banner for a critical condition (allergy, contraindication, panic value, over-dose) that announces assertively, requires an explicit acknowledgement, and exposes that acked state so the consumer can block a sign-off until it's cleared. Stronger than Alert (which is presentational and has no acknowledge contract).

actionProgress.title: ActionProgress
actionProgress.description: Blocking feedback for a short action (save, send, redirect), composed from Dialog, Progress (indeterminate) and Spinner. It appears only when the action is still pending after delayMs (default 350ms), so fast work never flashes a modal, and closes as soon as open turns false. Never shows a percentage. FormActionProgress reads the enclosing form's pending state via React 19 useFormStatus. Not for long work with a visual or a cancel — that is ProgressDialog.

routeProgress.title: RouteProgress
routeProgress.description: A thin indeterminate bar pinned to the top of the viewport (or of a positioned container) while a page or view loads. Framework-agnostic: render it from any loading boundary and unmount it when done. Built on Progress indeterminate, so there is one sweep implementation; it never shows a percentage and becomes a still, dimmed bar under reduced motion.
